results.title: What's Wrong Wendy?
results.overview: Wendy Day is a young woman struggling to find her place in a world that has always felt slightly out of step. When a string of brutal murders shakes the town, Wendy is pulled into a hidden war between vampires, demons, and ancient forces lurking beneath the surface of everyday life. As dark secrets begin to unravel, Wendy discovers that the answers may be tied not only to the town’s bloody history, but to her own connection to the supernatural.  Alongside her fiercely protective sister Arlo and her estranged high school crush Victoria Sinclair, Wendy must navigate a growing nightmare of monsters, betrayal, and impossible choices. As the body count rises and the line between friend and foe begins to blur, Wendy finds herself at the center of a mystery that threatens to consume Sequoia Lake and everyone she loves.

results.title: WOLFSTORY (PILOT)
results.overview: Set in a dark world filled with ancient magic, WOLFSTORY follows three young wolves who set out on a quest to save their pack and rewrite their own stories.

results.title: Countenance
results.overview: Asha is a young man with the ability to feel and resonate other people's emotions through physical contact. Turned into a recluse by the burden of his abilities, he is constantly plagued with the predicament of whether he should strip people of their negative emotions but consequently bare the burden himself or does he turn a blind eye, and leave people to their suffering?

results.title: Ultra Strong
results.overview: Catherine tries to toughen herself to impress the “princes” in her circle, who turn out to be more off-putting than charming. When all her dubious strategies fail, she must face the ultimate test: learning how to embrace her true nature.  In Ultra Strong, a candid and self-deprecating autofictional story by Catherine Lepage, we’re invited to reexamine our youthful ideals—from Cinderella to Iron Maiden.

results.title: The Com: Online, Sadistic and Deadly.
results.original_title: The Com: Online, Sadistic and Deadly.
results.overview: Parents are being warned of the dangers of ‘The Com’ or ‘764’, a sadistic online network that targets often vulnerable young people, destroying their lives. Sky's Adele Robinson reports using testimony from survivors, parents, law enforcement investigators and journalists, as they try to understand this new global grooming terror.

results.title: Meet-Cute
results.overview: Jaded by endless dates, two anxious misfits decide to reveal everything – pet peeves, red flags and sexual dealbreakers – in a brutally honest encounter that might just become something more.

results.title: Bialiatski / Unbroken
results.overview: A journey into the lived reality of international human rights, observed from within long-term relationships and shared time. At its centre stands Ales Bialiatski, Nobel Peace Prize laureate, whose presence emerges through the voices of those who have lived and worked alongside him over decades. The film is carried by two women - his wife Natalia Pinchuk and his closest colleague Sasha Koulaeva. Through memory, routine gestures and years of shared experience, they reveal what it means to remain with someone when history moves in circles rather than forward. Moving across places marked by authoritarian experience, from Belarus to Tunisia and Colombia, the film follows a recurring rhythm of hope, exhaustion and return, linking human rights defenders across borders and generations. A film shaped by endurance, loyalty and the quiet persistence of human dignity over time.

results.title: Michael Jackson : Les derniers secrets du roi de la Pop
results.original_title: Michael Jackson : Les derniers secrets du roi de la Pop

results.title: The Violinist
results.overview: It is Singapore in the late 1930s. Kai and Fei are childhood friends and aspiring violinists. When Japan invades Malaya in 1941, Kai chooses to forgo his music career to join the anti-Japanese forces. After the war Kai goes missing. Determined to find him, Fei performs all over Southeast Asia, all the while seeking any news of Kai. Yet, as time fades, Fei has to decide if she must find her own music to define the remaining years of her life.

results.title: The Rupture
results.overview: When a daycare refuses to let her children inside, Olivia, a single mother in Tijuana, is pushed into a relentless race across the city, where time, money and options quickly disappear.

results.title: Chrysalis
results.original_title: Mãi Nợ Một Lời Tạm Biệt
results.overview: In war-torn 1970s Vietnam, a resourceful young boy navigates his place in a chaotic world, guided by his grandmother’s wisdom while haunted by memories of his fractured family.

results.title: Making Monsters
results.overview: SFX and make-up designers Dave and Lou Elsey talk candidly about their inspirations, the joy of their work and their hopes for the future

results.title: Mashenka
results.overview: What happens when the boundaries between the observer and the subject are obliterated? When love appears not as a polished image, but in the guise of a homeless, drunk, and wounded person whom the world has turned its back on? This is a story about love that refuses to acknowledge the "social gutter". It is about equality that cannot be imposed, but can be experienced. In this film, reality rewrites the script. What was intended as a documentary about volunteers helping the homeless suddenly transforms into a chronicle of an impossible love affair. The film producer falls in love with the protagonist – a homeless man named Edik. The camera captures not only the social drama but an inner revolution which comes at a price. The struggle with addiction, rejection, the lure of the streets, and the fear of being authentic. Yet, against all odds, in this struggle we discern a radical act of recognizing humanity in someone who is usually overlooked.

results.title: I Know Exactly How You Die
results.original_title: I Know Exactly How You Die
results.overview: When his slasher-fiction novel manifests in real life, hack writer Rian Burman has to finish his story without getting his protagonist murdered by a seriously sadistic Stalker who will stop at nothing to have her.

results.title: Elodie
results.overview: After separating from her husband Medhi, Elodie’s life is thrown off balance. When she learns, while staying at her parents’ house, of an event from her early childhood that had been kept secret for decades, she begins to explore the causes of her emotional blockages. The search for the truth leads her into her own past and confronts her with family silence, repressed memories, and the question of how early experiences shape a person’s life.

results.title: Thirteen in Gaza
results.overview: Palestinian director Hosam Abu Dan makes his narrative feature debut with a nuanced and deeply human portrait of a father and his teenage daughter navigating everyday life in a refugee camp in the Gaza Strip.

results.title: Ye Live at SoFi
results.overview: Ye, the artist formerly known as Kanye West, performs live at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, as part of the “BULLY” tour on April 3, 2026.

results.title: They Know
results.overview: After witnessing the murder of a squirrel, a cabal of woodland creatures summon the forces of darkness to balance the scales.

results.title: Too Many Beasts
results.overview: In the French countryside, wild boars ravaging crops spark an open war between farmers and members of a gentlemen’s hunting club, who feed the game between hunts. Brun, a bankrupt farmer, struggles to keep his farm afloat. When the club’s president pushes him to his limits, Brun shoots him and disappears. A year later, Fulda, a volatile police officer just transferred to the region, leads the investigation. Still struggling after a recent breakup, and as wild boars proliferate across the region, he is pushed to the brink of sanity.
